fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Wheeled mechanized platoons in FWLM service ride armored personnel carriers that offer good road speed and reasonable protection, making them well-suited to the League's developed industrial worlds where paved infrastructure supports rapid deployment between population centers. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers, these platoons pack anti-armor punch that standard rifle or laser formations cannot match, capable of threatening light vehicles and even damaging BattleMech leg actuators at close range.
